_create2(bytes32,bytes).details: External so it can be wrapped in try/catch (Solidity limitation).

params.gasLimit: Gas allocated for execution on each target chain.
params.target: Contract address on each target chain (must be same address; use deterministic deployment).
params.targetChains: Wormhole chain IDs to deliver to.

params.bytecode: Compiled contract bytecode (constructor args appended if any).
params.deployOnCurrentChain: If true, also deploy on the source chain in this tx.
params.initCalldata: Called on the deployed contract after CREATE2. Pass "" to skip.
params.salt: CREATE2 salt — same contract address on every chain.
params.targetChains: Wormhole chain IDs of destination chains.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

proxiableUUID().details: Implementation of the ERC-1822 {proxiableUUID} function. This returns the storage slot used by the implementation. It is used to validate the implementation's compatibility when performing an upgrade. IMPORTANT: A proxy pointing at a proxiable contract should not be considered proxiable itself, because this risks bricking a proxy that upgrades to it, by delegating to itself until out of gas. Thus it is critical that this function revert if invoked through a proxy. This is guaranteed by the `notDelegated` modifier.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

params.newImpl: New implementation address (must be same on all chains).
params.proxy: Proxy contract address (must be same on all chains via deterministic deploy).
params.upgradeOnCurrentChain: If true, also upgrade on the source chain in this tx.

upgradeToAndCall(address,bytes).details: Upgrade the implementation of the proxy to `newImplementation`, and subsequently execute the function call encoded in `data`. Calls {_authorizeUpgrade}. Emits an {Upgraded} event.

callAcrossChains(uint16[],address,bytes,.notice: Send an arbitrary cross-chain function call through the WormDeployer hub.

computeAddress(bytes32,bytes).notice: Compute the CREATE2 address for a given salt and bytecode.

deployAcrossChains(uint16[],bytes,bytes3.notice: Deploy bytecode to multiple target chains via Wormhole Standard Relayer.

getCallCost(uint16[],uint256).notice: Total ETH cost to send a call to `chains` with `gasLimit` per chain.

getDeployCost(uint16[]).notice: Total ETH cost to deploy to `chains` (uses fixed DEPLOY_GAS_LIMIT).

getUpgradeCost(uint16[]).notice: Total ETH cost to upgrade proxies on `chains` (uses fixed UPGRADE_GAS_LIMIT).

initialize(address).notice: Initialize the WormDeployer with the Wormhole relayer address.

setTrustedSender(uint16,bytes32).notice: Register the WormDeployer address on a peer chain.

upgradeAcrossChains(uint16[],address,add.notice: Upgrade a UUPS proxy to a new implementation across multiple chains.
